item.title: Crookston 12U Girls Hockey team finishes 2nd in District 16 12UB tournament, advances to Regions
item.description: The Crookston 12U Girls Hockey team finished second place at the 12UB District 16 tournament and advances to the Regional tournament in Virginia, Minnesota. Crookston beat East Grand Forks in the first round 4-1. Scoring goals for Crookston were Hadley Solberg, Clara Vigness, Kaleigh Longoria, and Evelyn Gasper.
